brief_rationale: The doctor performed comprehensive workspace queries and provided calibrated interpretation of the biopsy result with medication safety boundaries. RC1-RC8 were met with no in-chain errors. HO1 was completed through active correction of the patient's misconception that symptom improvement meant medication could be stopped. HO3 was completed through evidence-based calibration reconciling biopsy pathology with current stable labs. HO4 was completed by adapting the follow-up plan to the patient's work constraints and local hospital access. The patient provided clear teach-back confirming corrected understanding. Valid closure achieved.
